details:
I would like to request the ability for wold creators to have the option to make a "display" or "test" pedestal, where users can test out avatars but not have the ability to Favorite the avatar, or leave the world with the avatar.
the intent of this feature is to help creators display their work without having to create multiple versions for free water down versions of the avatars.
Example Case 1:
User joins a creator's world, and wants to test avatars before deciding to purchase an avatar or not.
Creator makes one or more display pedestals, where user can try them out and find out if they are right for them.
User is unable to Favorite the avatar or leave with the test avatar.
Example Case 2:
Creator makes a game with costume avatars, and the creator wishes that the avatars are only used for the game, in this world only.
User can choose to change to the avatar, yet not being able to leave the designated area with it.
title: Temporary World Avatar pedestal
